info.name: LEGLINK-142 - Org-location reportability (self-contained local E2E)
info.description:
Self-contained manual E2E for LEGLINK-142 / org-location reportability, exercised through existing APIs. One Organization owns several Locations identified by an identifier (system 'http://hospital.example.org/locations'). The OrganizationLocationConfiguration maps the org locations by identifier (hosp-a OR hosp-b). A patient is reportable only when their encounter's Location is an org location (directly or via partOf); otherwise the non-org encounter is stripped before MeasureEval and the patient is excluded from the report.

Patients (one transaction bundle, all under the same org):
  - patient-a -> Encounter at hosp-a (mapped)        => REPORTABLE
  - patient-b -> Encounter at hosp-b (mapped)        => REPORTABLE
  - patient-c -> Encounter at hosp-c (NOT mapped)    => NOT REPORTABLE (excluded from report)

Locations also include er-a/er-b (partOf hosp-a) and er-c (partOf hosp-c) to represent the org structure; an encounter at er-b would inherit org status from hosp-a.

LOCAL STACK ONLY (Authentication__EnableAnonymousAccess=true -> no token). Link calls go through the Admin BFF (:8063); FHIR data is loaded to the HAPI server on the host (:6157); the facility config points the SERVICES at it via the internal docker name (fhir-server:8080).

Folder 0 embeds the measure bundle and a pre-request script pulls the 5 NHSN ValueSets from the terminology service ({{terminology}}) so the CQL engine can evaluate Initial Population. ValueSets come from terminology (its data folder / ABS volume), not the repo.

RUN ORDER: 0 Load measure -> 1 Create facility & org-location plan -> 2 Enable gating -> 3 Seed patients -> 4 Trigger -> (wait ~60-90s for acquisition + MeasureEval + report) -> 5 Observe.

Bump 'facilityId' for a clean re-run (the create steps reject duplicates). Folder 5's report-entry checks need the pipeline to reach MeasureEval/Report, so allow extra time before running them; re-run folder 5 if a 'no report entry yet' assertion fails.

item.name: PUT measure definition (embedded bundle + valuesets from terminology)

request.description: Loads the Measure + Libraries (embedded). A pre-request script fetches the 5 referenced NHSN ValueSets from the terminology service ({{terminology}}) and injects them before sending, so the CQL engine can evaluate Initial Population. ValueSets are sourced from terminology (network/ABS volume), not the repo. The patients' emergency (EMER) encounters satisfy Initial Population via the [Encounter: class ~ 'emergency'] arm. Measure definitions are global to MeasureEval.

request.description: Creates the facility/tenant. Vendor is required (Epic).

item.name: POST org-location query plan (Encounter, Condition, Location-ref)

request.description: INITIAL: Encounter (Parameter) + Condition (Parameter, depends on Encounter ids) + Location (Reference). SUPPLEMENTAL: a throwaway Observation (validator requires >=1). Parameter queries must precede Reference queries.
Points the facility at fhir-server:8080 and turns on EnableLocationResolutionMapping so encounter Locations are resolved and evaluated against the org-location conditions.

item.name: POST org-location config (identifier hosp-a OR hosp-b)

request.description: Active org-location config. FhirPath: a Location is an org location when its identifier (system 'http://hospital.example.org/locations') value is hosp-a or hosp-b. Children inherit org status through partOf.

item.name: 3. Seed patients in FHIR (one org, identifier-bearing locations)

request.description: Transaction bundle: 6 identifier-bearing Locations (hosp-a/b/c + er-a/er-b partOf hosp-a + er-c partOf hosp-c) and 3 Patients, each with an Encounter at hosp-a/hosp-b/hosp-c respectively plus a Condition. Loaded to HAPI on the host.
Kicks off one acquisition over all three patients. Wait ~60-90s before folder 5 so DataAcq + MeasureEval + Report settle.

item.name: 5. Observe (a/b reportable, c excluded from report)

request.description: Encounter at org location hosp-a -> mappedToOrg true.

exec: pm.test('patient-a: has an encounter mapping', function () { pm.expect(recs.length).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('patient-a: mappedToOrg === true', function () { pm.expect(recs.every(function(r){return r.mappedToOrg===true;})).to.be.true; });

request.description: Encounter at org location hosp-b -> mappedToOrg true.

exec: pm.test('patient-b: has an encounter mapping', function () { pm.expect(recs.length).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('patient-b: mappedToOrg === true', function () { pm.expect(recs.every(function(r){return r.mappedToOrg===true;})).to.be.true; });

request.description: Encounter at non-org location hosp-c -> mappedToOrg false.

exec: pm.test('patient-c: has an encounter mapping', function () { pm.expect(recs.length).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('patient-c: mappedToOrg === false', function () { pm.expect(recs.every(function(r){return r.mappedToOrg===false;})).to.be.true; });

request.description: Non-org patient: dependent Condition log is preempted (NotReportable).

exec: pm.test('patient-c: dependent Condition log is NotReportable', function () { pm.expect(byType['Condition']).to.equal('NotReportable'); });

item.name: GET report entry - patient-a (in the report)

request.description: Reportable patient: a report entry exists with reportingStatus != NotReportable(1).

exec: pm.test('patient-a: report entry exists for this facility', function () { pm.expect(entry, 'no report entry yet - wait longer').to.not.be.undefined; });
pm.test('patient-a: reportingStatus is NOT NotReportable (in the report)', function () { pm.expect(entry.reportingStatus).to.not.equal(1); });

pm.test('patient-b: reportingStatus is NOT NotReportable (in the report)', function () { pm.expect(entry.reportingStatus).to.not.equal(1); });

request.description: Non-org patient: the non-org encounter is stripped before MeasureEval, so reportingStatus === NotReportable(1) and no aggregate report is produced.
